findings.莫大: Unattributed factory meeting is narrated as an actual event; make the decision scenario explicitly hypothetical and avoid inevitable purchase conclusion.
findings.国策: Government objectives and corporate motives are stated as exhaustive universals; scope them as examples and profitability emphasis.
findings.補助金: Effects are not only measurable years later; ongoing location obligations depend on program conditions, not universal subsidy rule.
findings.躍進: Invented company success contrast presented as actual history; replace with conditional operational example and include checking costs.
findings.頭打ち: Flat smartphone shipments do not necessarily mean demand saturation; distinguish observed plateau from alternative causes.
findings.EUV露光: EUV is not the shortest electromagnetic light; dim-photo blur analogy does not explain diffraction, and whole equipment is not made only of mirrors.
findings.シリコンの盾: Concentration does not imply that one region halts every semiconductor supply; qualify geographic propagation and retain hypothesis status.
findings.アルゴリズム: Sorting before a single search can cost more than linear scanning; distinguish preprocessing cost from repeated-query benefit.
findings.探索と活用: Replace overly broad cognitive-framework/investment advice with a concrete recommendation-system tradeoff and finite-horizon uncertainty.
